questions.q: Only members of the HR group may see real social security numbers; everyone else sees a masked value. What is the documented way to do this on one table?

questions.q: Who can set a row filter or column mask on a table?

questions.q: Hundreds of tables contain columns tagged PII, and new ones are added weekly. What is Databricks' recommended approach to mask them consistently?

options.t: A column mask set by hand on each table, with a review each week
options.why: Per-table masks don't scale; ABAC policies cover tagged columns automatically.

options.t: An ABAC policy on governed tags, attached to the catalog or schema
Dynamic views for every table, created by a nightly job
options.why: ABAC is the recommended approach for consistency across many tables.

options.t: Revoking SELECT on all PII tables and granting it case by case
options.why: That blocks whole tables; ABAC masks the tagged columns.

questions.explain: ABAC policies use governed tags and a policy attached to a catalog, schema or table; new tables with the tag are covered automatically, and table owners can't override the policy.

questions.q: An ABAC column-mask policy is attached to a catalog. A new table with a PII-tagged column is created in it. What applies?

options.t: The policy covers it automatically, and the table owner can't override it
The policy, but only after the catalog's grants are re-run

questions.explain: New tables that carry the tag are covered automatically, and table owners can't override the policy.

questions.q: Which policy types can an ABAC policy be?

Column mask
VACUUM retention

The filter is ignored for members of the admins group
